title: USS John C. Stennis CVN-74 [Nimitz class aircraft carrier, scale 1:1]
author: Helix_area51

title.en: USS John C. Stennis Aircraft Carrier

generated.description: A large-scale, near 1:1 replica of the Nimitz-class aircraft carrier USS John C. Stennis (CVN-74), built mostly from light gray, gray, and white wool with stone slab and quartz details for the flight deck and superstructure. It measures about 333 blocks long, 75 high, and 85 deep, and uses roughly 98,700 blocks in total. The source has no description and no block entities, so the interior is not documented.
